peer_results.rationale: AVGO candidates focus on VMware Cloud Foundation software licensing and cloud infrastructure capabilities, which are unrelated to the target's discussion of physical graphics processing hardware and its direct use cases in visualization and AI workloads.

comparisons.peer_summary: The Intel Arc graphics family powers immersive games, creator applications, and AI workloads. In 2024, Intel launched the Arc B-Series based on Xe2 architecture, featuring second-generation Xe-cores that deliver 70% more performance per core and 50% better power efficiency than the Intel Arc A750.
comparisons.comparison: Both AMD and Intel describe their discrete graphics products as enabling immersive visualization and supporting AI workloads. AMD states that customers use their graphics solutions for 'immersive visualization and to process AI/ML based workloads,' while Intel's Arc graphics family is described as powering 'immersive games, creator applications, and AI workloads.' Both identify these specific use cases as key drivers for their graphics hardware.

sentences.text: Our customers generally use our graphics solutions to enable immersive visualization and to process AI/ML based workloads.

The Intel® Arc™ graphics family offers modern GPU features to power immersive games, creator applications, and AI workloads. In 2024, we launched the Intel Arc B-Series based on the latest Xe2 GPU architecture. The compute engine of the Intel Arc B-Series is our second-generation Xe-core, which delivers 70% more performance per core and is 50% more power efficient than the Intel Arc A750.

comparisons.peer_summary: The graphics market is driven by AI, VR/AR, and high-resolution gaming needs; the company announced GDDR7 in 2024, completing its industry-leading portfolio for AI inference on CPUs, NPUs, and GPUs.
comparisons.comparison: Both AMD and Micron identify AI as a primary market driver for graphics-related products. AMD notes its graphics solutions are used to 'process AI/ML based workloads,' while Micron states its graphics market products (GDDR) support 'applications such as AI.' Additionally, both mention the expansion of graphics into data center solutions, with AMD developing products for 'data centers' and Micron noting its products are used in 'graphics processing unit-based data center solutions.'

sentences.text: Graphics processing is a fundamental component across many of our products.

We develop our graphics products for use in various computing devices and entertainment platforms, including data centers, desktop PCs, notebook PCs, handheld devices, All-in-Ones, and professional workstations.

Our GDDR6 and GDDR6X DRAM graphics products are incorporated into gaming consoles, PC graphics cards, and graphics processing unit-based data center solutions, which are the driving force behind applications such as AI, virtual and augmented reality, 4K and 8K gaming, and professional design.

comparisons.peer_topic: Paid Software Licensing (AI Enterprise and vGPU)
comparisons.peer_summary: In addition to integral software, the company offers paid licenses to NVIDIA AI Enterprise, a suite of enterprise-grade AI software, and NVIDIA vGPU software for graphics-rich virtual desktops and workstations.
comparisons.comparison: Both AMD and NVIDIA disclose the provision of software alongside their hardware graphics/computing platforms to support specific workloads. AMD highlights the use of its graphics technology for 'AI/ML based workloads,' while NVIDIA offers 'NVIDIA AI Enterprise, a comprehensive suite of enterprise-grade AI software.' Both companies position their graphics ecosystems as central to enabling advanced AI capabilities for their customers.

sentences.text: Our customers generally use our graphics solutions to enable immersive visualization and to process AI/ML based workloads.

In addition to software delivered to customers as an integral part of our data center computing platform, we offer paid licenses to NVIDIA AI Enterprise, a comprehensive suite of enterprise-grade AI software and NVIDIA vGPU software for graphics-rich virtual desktops and workstations.
